_readme: Quota tiers, split into groups. Inside each group a member gets the FIRST tier whose role they hold (top to bottom). Someone in both groups (e.g. a Moderator who is also IA) is checked against both. Role keys = the role slots in /setup roles. weeklyHours null = no quota. The bot owner can change hours live with /quota set.

trial.onFail: Demoted back to Senior Moderator or Moderator
Terminated - must redo the application and training

tiers.label: Internal Affairs
notes: Everything must be logged or it won't count
Judge alongside actual ticket volume - don't punish IA for a lack of reports

ia.label: Internal Affairs
ia.manualNote: Hours come from Vex; cases come from each IA member's logs (every "... Logged" entry counts as one). Investigations and documentation quality must be checked manually. Repeated inactivity without an approved reason → inactivity warning, infraction, or removal from IA.

_enforcement_readme: Applied to tiers with enforced: true, using hours logged in the week. First match wins.
